name: XAE-Swing v1 (frozen 2026-11-07, before any holdout data was used)
instrument: XAUUSD (research feed XAUUSD.c; live account CFI XAUUSD_, contract 100 oz, 0.01 lot = 1 oz)
timeframe: Daily bars; trading day ends at the daily halt (17:00 New York = 00:00 server NY+7)

indicators.entry_channel: highest HIGH of the previous 20 completed days (today excluded)
indicators.exit_channel: lowest LOW of the previous 10 completed days (today excluded)
indicators.ATR: 20-day Wilder ATR (EMA of true range, alpha = 1/20)

entry: If today's daily CLOSE > entry_channel and no position is open -> BUY at the next day's open (practically: after 01:05 server, once the reopen spread has normalised)
initial_stop: entry price - 2.0 x ATR20 (ATR of the signal day)
trailing_stop: after each daily close: stop = max(stop, highest close since entry - 2.0 x ATR20). Checked intraday; a gap below the stop fills at the open
exit: If the daily CLOSE < exit_channel -> SELL at the next day's open; or the stop is hit
re_entry_after_stop: No new entry until the exit-channel condition has reset (system state goes flat) and a fresh 20-day breakout close occurs
costs_assumed: $0.50 per side (spread + slippage at the reopen); swap CFI: long -515.76 pts/night (~4.6%/yr), triple on Wednesday
